title: Upgraded Stonecutter
description: You can now use cobblestone in a stonecutter to turn it into stone!
body:
This Mod allows you to turn cobblestone or cobbled deepslate into regular stone/deepslate in a stonecutter!
Very simple mod, Of course. But its extremely useful and unlike datapacks which do the same thing, this one is for all worlds/servers!
(PS: Must download the mod on your client for it to work when installed on servers.)
